doc.description:
EARcam acoustic loud-spot search over the MORA camera UART link.
During a survey block the module sends EARcam-targeted shoot commands through digital_cam_uart at earcam_period_s; the MORA companion computer (CATIA with --earcam) geotags its microphone level with the transmitted position. On earcam_stop() MORA computes the loudest spot and returns it; the flight plan then applies it to a waypoint with earcam_result_to_waypoint(WP).
Typical flight plan sequence (see talon_earcam_loudspot_demo.xml): earcam_start(), survey, earcam_solve(), wait for earcam_result_fresh, then refine: earcam_refine_setup(WP_FROM, WP_TO, WP_TURN), fly route FROM to TO, circle WP_TURN with earcam_refine_turn_radius() while earcam_refine_turning(), earcam_refine_next_leg(...) until it returns 1, earcam_solve(), wait for earcam_result_fresh, earcam_refine_update(), repeat until earcam_refine_converged; finally earcam_stop() and earcam_result_to_waypoint(WP_DROP).
Block exceptions run before the block body, so never request a solve and test earcam_result_fresh in the same block: request in one block, wait in the next. earcam_result_valid stays true once any result was received; earcam_result_fresh is set by each reply and consumed by earcam_refine_setup()/earcam_refine_update().
The refinement star is fixed-wing flyable: straight legs through the estimate joined by circle turns placed as fillets tangent to both legs. Legs end at the tangent points (max(EARCAM_REFINE_HALF_LENGTH_M, R/tan(90/N)) from the centre, R = |nav_radius|), so the turn exits exactly onto the next leg and each pass over the estimate is a straight, wings-level run-in. EAR shots advance the photo number; DC_SHOT telemetry is limited to one report per EARCAM_REPORT_PERIOD_S.
Known search area (IMAV Mission 4, alarm within 25 m of a given point): skip the survey, earcam_start(), earcam_result_from_waypoint(WP_CENTER), then the star as above; reject a result with !earcam_result_within(WP_CENTER, 35). With EARCAM_REFINE_HEIGHT_FROM_M set the star legs are placed at heights above ground_alt (start/turn height_from, end height_to, lowered by height_step per star, never below height_min) so a leg can be flown as a glide. With earcam_quiet_only samples are only taken while the throttle is killed for earcam_quiet_delay_s (pusher propeller masks the alarm): kill the throttle on the legs, restore it for the turns.
Low release: the nav_drop module flies the approach and computes the release point (see include_obc2014_mission.xml). earcam_drop_level_point(WP_START, WP_RELEASE, WP_TARGET, WP_LEVEL, 50) puts a level-off point 50 m before the release point at earcam_drop_release_agl_m; glide START to LEVEL (vmode glide), then route LEVEL to RELEASE with alt=earcam_drop_altitude(WP_TARGET) (release height, on the rangefinder when EARCAM_USE_AGL_DIST and in range). earcam_drop_too_low(WP_TARGET) asks for a go-around, earcam_drop_shoot(WP_TARGET) opens the hatch through nav_drop_shoot() only at or below earcam_drop_max_agl_m (EARCAM_USE_NAV_DROP) and sets earcam_drop_released/missed.

define.name: EARCAM_REPORT_PERIOD_S
define.description: minimum interval between DC_SHOT telemetry reports of EAR samples (0 = every sample)

define.name: EARCAM_REFINE_CONVERGE_M
define.description: stop refining when the estimate moves less than this

define.name: EARCAM_REFINE_TURN_RADIUS_M
define.description: star turn circle radius in m, 0 = |nav_radius|

define.name: EARCAM_REFINE_HEIGHT_FROM_M
define.description: leg start and turn height above ground_alt, 0 = keep waypoint altitudes

define.name: EARCAM_REFINE_HEIGHT_TO_M
define.description: leg end height above ground_alt (gliding leg)

define.name: EARCAM_REFINE_HEIGHT_STEP_M
define.description: lower the leg heights by this per completed star

define.name: EARCAM_REFINE_HEIGHT_MIN_M
define.description: never place a leg lower than this

define.name: EARCAM_QUIET_ONLY
define.description: sample only while the throttle is killed (fixed-wing)

define.name: EARCAM_USE_AGL_DIST
define.description: use the agl_dist rangefinder for the release height

define.name: EARCAM_DROP_AGL_MAX_M
define.description: trust the rangefinder up to this height

define.name: EARCAM_DROP_ABORT_AGL_M
define.description: go around below this rangefinder height
